decision_rule: CPU-only source and installed-ELF census, model-free, no GPU work. Record candidate source hashes and URLs, exact ELF hashes, symbols, strings and build notes. Missing inputs, changed ELF or failed tools yield UNKNOWN; serializer source, binary/source equivalence and profiler GPU ID to BDF always UNKNOWN. Stop on completed inventory or first STOP/deadline; no inference or device mapping.
reservation_rationale: 300 seconds admission for four source hashes and two ELF digests and six bounded tools, each 20 seconds maximum.
stop_on_answer: Finish once both ELFs and source files have been inventoried, or record UNKNOWN for unavailable inputs.
stop_on_futility: STOP, deadline, input seal failure, source or ELF ambiguity; no retries.
notes: Candidate upstream source is pinned but not asserted to produce installed binaries. Serializer source not established. No model, GPU or target.
